title: UK PPI — December 2026, including services October to December 2026 (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET) — the quarterly SPPI block that 16 December does NOT carry
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/producerpriceinflationukdecember2026includingservicesoctobertodecember2026, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the ONS release page reads verbatim 'Producer price inflation, UK: December 2026 including services, October to December 2026', 'Release date: 20 January 2027 7:00am', 'This release is not yet published'. Cadence corroborated from the publisher's own previous-releases listing, fetched the same day: the December reference month carries the services rider every year and publishes in January ('December 2025 including services, October to December 2025 — Released 21 January 2026'). Filed estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics. Proposed by the never-assessed initial research of uk-ppi-2026-12-16, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-ppi-2026-12-16 LANE, 2026-09-09. Why it earns a slot, and why it is proposed from outside the five-day corridor: it is the release that settles a claim two ledgers currently get wrong. events/uk-ppi-2026-11-18.md's signal block states that UK services producer prices 'are on 10-21 and 12-16'; the publisher's own release pages say otherwise — the quarterly Services Producer Price Index rides the March/June/September/DECEMBER reference months, so the October-December 2026 services block publishes 20 January 2027 and the 16 December 2026 print is goods-only. This entry is where that block actually lands. It also continues the same-minute pairing this chain has now verified on five consecutive ONS release pages (09-16, 10-21, 11-18, 12-16, 2027-01-20): uk-cpi-2027-01-20 is already proposed at the same 07:00 London minute by the uk-cpi-2026-12-16 lane, so 2027-01-20 is another two-release 02:00 ET slot. Third reason: it is the first UK producer-price print of 2027 and the first whose reference month prices on or near 1 December 2026 (ONS PPI QMI first-of-month rule), i.e. the first to see whatever the 1 December oil quote does after the 17 December MPC vote. Tiered LOW on the same grounds as every sibling in this chain: symbols: [], no rates- or sterling-keyed house playbook, attribution value only. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
